judge: the project owner (HCI student), one person
caveats: One judge and one run per configuration: a signal, not a measured effect (the judge's own warning: 'my judgement may be biased, and it is one sample').
The judge had seen the key of the iteration-2 page, so they may recognise the skill's style; the X/Y mapping was re-randomised and differed from iteration 2.
The baselines are the iteration-1 runs, shown again in iterations 2 and 3.
method: Local blind page with each pair's 375 px and 1280 px full-page screenshots; sites labelled X and Y at random (seed 7), the key revealed only after all answers. One presentation order per pair.
agreement_with_llm: 3 of 4 screenshot verdicts agree; the human found the skill's cafe page more beautiful, the model preferred the baseline.
